title: FLA import: GIF bitmap format not detected — silently dropped
description: In packages/core/src/fla/media.ts, decodeMediaBitmap() detects JPEG (FFD8FF), PNG (89504E47), Flash lossless, and zlib-wrapped variants — but has no GIF detection. A GIF payload falls through all cases and returns null, silently dropping the bitmap from the library. GIF uses magic bytes GIF87a (47494637386100 start) or GIF89a (47494637396100 start). Fix: add a GIF detection branch in decodeMediaBitmap(). For the decoded output, convert the GIF to PNG using the browser's canvas API or a pure-JS GIF decoder (check if any dependency is available). If no GIF decoder is available, at minimum decode the GIF dimensions from the header and return a placeholder or log a warning instead of null. In the worst case, convert GIF to a black ARGB bitmap of the same dimensions so the library item exists rather than disappearing silently.
